raw: {"analysis": "Both responses provide comprehensive plans covering the key constraints: dual-write configuration, latency auto-pause, PR approvals, CI cost/flaky check handling, Sunday maintenance windows, irreversibility of backfill, and zero-data-loss reporting. However, GSV incorrectly imposes a mandatory 90-day wait before starting historical backfill, stating it cannot begin until dual-write has been live for 90 days, whereas the request only requires maintaining LegacyStream for 90 days while verifying query parity and says backfill should start once dual-writing is stable.
